short: The peace agreement that ended the Anarchy and established the Plantagenet dynasty.
full:
Agreed in the summer of 1153, the Treaty of Wallingford brought an end to the nineteen-year civil war known as the Anarchy. After years of military stalemate, the war-weary barons on both sides refused to fight when the armies of King Stephen and Henry Plantagenet faced each other across the Thames. The sudden death of Stephen's eldest son, Eustace, removed the primary obstacle to a negotiated succession.

The treaty stipulated that Stephen would remain king of England for the rest of his life, but recognised Henry as his adopted son and legitimate heir. It also mandated the destruction of the numerous unlicensed castles that had proliferated during the conflict. When Stephen died the following year, Henry ascended the throne peacefully as Henry II, initiating over three centuries of Plantagenet rule.
